value.reason: Quantity.limitPerUser is an integer setting (DataTypes.INTEGER, isInt validator) that caps how many units one user can claim. It is business configuration, not information about a person: it holds no identifiers, contact details, credentials, or financial, health, biometric or child data. The schema requires a category, so it is labeled Profile, the lowest-sensitivity option, because it shapes per-user limits. It is not really personal data.
